name: glove-working-environment
description: A small, fast, in-memory, sandboxed persistent working environment for LLM agents — a virtual filesystem the model acts on across many tool calls: write and persist scripts, run them, capture outputs, inspect intermediates, and iterate. No networking, no host filesystem, no process spawning: scripts execute in a scope containing only injected capabilities (env:fs, env:std, registered stdlib adapters). Zero-dependency core; heavy format libraries live in adapter packages.
